description:
On #2769 a merge of develop was pushed at 14:02 UTC as commit 1e08adaa1 (author Joe Harris, committer GitHub web-flow, timeline actor "GitHub", verified) right after a close/reopen. All required checks then passed and no thread was open, but the pull request stayed BLOCKED. The develop ruleset sets require_extra_approval_for_unattributed_changes, and the author cannot approve their own pull request. Rebuilding the same tree as an author-made merge commit unblocked it. The update also invalidated a head-specific stand-in.

Source identified: the commit is GitHub's "Update branch" action run under the owner's credentials, not an unknown workflow or app. It has not recurred in the last 60 develop PRs. The remaining risk is someone using the button or `gh pr update-branch` again.
